replies.author: Pavlo
replies.body:
step 1. Download LiteLoader for your version fo Minecraft
Step 2. Open it and clock install
Step 3. Download WorldWrap for your version of minecraft (World edit for LiteLoader)
Step 4. Place it in your mods  folder in .minecraft
Step 5. LiteLoader will automatically create a laucnher profile for you - Start minecrfat and use that profile
